taking team/chat (a server process must implement a shutdown verb). Building it into R1.

Agreed, into R1. Every server gets 'shutdown' from its node over the IPC channel it already has. That's the node's own line to its child, never the pipe visitors come down, so no stranger can send it. The server finishes what it's doing, closes its pipe and exits. The node waits a few seconds, then kills it only if it hasn't gone. The kernel gives a server a one-line hook for it, so each app writes only what it must tidy. faceServer implements it too. Cancel in the jobs app sends shutdown first.
